label: /paintings — the drawer's X unfolds with the drawer: mounted in both states, folded away in peek, it animates in the moment the drawer starts to rise instead of appearing when the scroll settles
notes: Wil, 2026-09-22, on round 28: 'This is almost perfect. Nothing else needs to be changed except' the drawer's Close button, which 'takes too long to appear, it shows up maybe a second after the drawer is expanded, it seems like it appears out of nowhere, it should appear instantly by animating in with the expansion of the drawer.' Cause: the X was mounted by the drawer's React state, which the scroll-driven path (round 28) sets only once the scroll settles — on iOS, after the flick's momentum — and it mounted with no transition. This round: the X is mounted in both states and folded away in peek (height, margin, stroke and opacity at 0), unfolding over the house 300ms the moment the drawer's position passes 12% of its travel (`data-x` on the sheet from applySheet, with hysteresis), so it rises with the drawer whether the finger, the wheel or the page's scroll moves it; the drawer's travel is measured to the header without the X, so the mapping never jumps as it unfolds; the state itself now follows at the ends at once on the scroll path, as it does on the wheel. Numbered 31: rounds 29 and 30 (the map's lens) and round 23's device passes 13-15 (the chapter pages) shipped from other sessions meanwhile; this round was rebased onto their tip, 839b00f, which is its base. Nothing else changes; no route may drift.
